author: Devanshi Nishar
description: Online sports betting company DraftKings is using AI to target customers who are most likely to place losing bets and respond to gambling promotions. This kind of targeting is a form of online behavioral advertising, which is when companies personalize the ads they show you based on the data they’ve collected about you. title: DraftKings Is Using AI to Supercharge the Harms of Online Behavioral Advertising
